content.title: Implement: remove TypeDoc tooling from packages/library
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/user-docs-spec.md

Read the spec AND the review comments on issues mpdptgq69t and mpdpthrliu before starting. The reviews contain critical feedback about feasibility, edge cases, and impact.

Your task (AC1 from the spec):
1. Remove typedoc and typedoc-plugin-markdown from devDependencies in packages/library/package.json
2. Delete packages/library/typedoc.json
3. Remove scripts from packages/library/package.json: docs:html, docs:md, docs, docs:check
4. Verify quality script (bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:coverage) is unaffected
5. Verify prepublishOnly script (bun run quality) is unaffected
6. Run bun install to update lockfile
7. Run bun run quality to confirm nothing breaks
8. Run bun run build to confirm dist/ still works

After completion, comment with what was removed and verification results.

content.content: Context: typedoc is listed as devDependency with typedoc-plugin-markdown. There is a typedoc.json config file. Scripts docs:html, docs:md, docs, docs:check all reference typedoc. The quality script (bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:coverage) does NOT include docs:check, so removing docs scripts won't affect the quality gate. The release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) has a TypeDoc step but that's being handled separately by CTO in mpdpvfn3yb.
